{"diagnosis":"Batches 1-13 carry txn_ts in America/Chicago local time, but batch 14 (source_tz='UTC') carries UTC timestamps, 6 hours ahead. Its 12:03 UTC start is 06:03 Chicago, matching the other batches. The UTC rows from 00:00-04:56 on 01-19 are really 18:00-22:56 on 01-18 local time, so they were assigned to the wrong date. The fix normalizes UTC rows to Chicago local time (CST, UTC-6, no DST in January).","decision":"fix","confidence":0.88,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS
SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id,
       customer_id,
       CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id,
       CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount,
       CAST(CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts,
       CAST(CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS DATE) AS txn_date
FROM raw_transactions
WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
